content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: Retired from State Government / semi-government service, Group A or Group B (Gazetted) cadre, pay structure S-17 to S-23. Experience required: Minimum three years' experience of the relevant work. Age limit: Maximum 65 years. Pay: Total of basic pension (without commutation value) and dearness allowance thereon as monthly remuneration. Qualification required: Retired from State Government / semi-government service, Group B (Gazetted/Non-Gazetted) cadre, pay structure S-14 to S-16. Experience required: Minimum three years' experience of the relevant work. Age limit: Maximum 65 years. Pay: Total of basic pension (without commutation value) and dearness allowance thereon as monthly remuneration.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Monthly remuneration fixed as per Annexure-A of the General Administration Department GR dated 10.06.2025: basic pension at the time of appointment (without commutation value) plus dearness allowance on it. Appointment for at most one year at a time or until the post is filled by the prescribed method, whichever is earlier Extension as per Government Resolution provisions and decision of the competent authority No administrative or financial powers will be given No right to absorption or regular appointment in any government cadre Undertaking/bond accepting the terms to be taken before appointment Appointing authority may terminate the contract at any time in special circumstances

content_sections.heading: How Will SIC Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Selection considering eligibility, experience, work capability and performance in interview Eligibility, experience, work capability and performance in interview are considered

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Retirement order / relieving order (Relieve Memo) of the Head of Office Pension Payment Order (PPO) from the Accountant General office, Mumbai/Nagpur (self-attested copy) Certificate that no departmental enquiry is pending or proposed Educational qualification certificates MS-CIT pass certificate or equivalent proof of computer knowledge Experience certificate of relevant work and recent passport-size photograph

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SIC Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Obtain the prescribed application form from www.maharashtra.gov.in or www.sic.maharashtra.gov.in. Fill in the form and attach self-attested copies of the required documents. Submit in person or by post to the Joint Secretary, State Information Commission, Pune Bench, Pune, New Administrative Building, Fourth Floor, Opposite Vidhan Bhavan, Pune - 411001. Application must be received by 07-12-2026; incomplete or late applications will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications or those received after the deadline will not be considered Attaching the required documents is mandatory Combined residence, travel and telephone allowance up to 25% of monthly remuneration Travel and daily allowance for official tours as per Government Resolution Complete confidentiality of office documents and data is mandatory Provisions of GAD GRs dated 10.06.2025 and 04.11.2026 apply

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for SIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 7 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in SIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Section Officer, 2 Assistant Section Officer.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for SIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (www.maharashtra.gov.in and www.sic.maharashtra.gov.in; form also printed on pages 5 to 8 of this PDF) and send it to Joint Secretary, State Information Commission, Pune Bench, Pune, New Administrative Building, Fourth Floor, Opposite Vidhan Bhavan, Pune - 411001, by in person or by post, to reach by 7 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 65 years (as on the date of publication of the advertisement).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Total of basic pension (without commutation value) and dearness allowance thereon as monthly remuneration for Section Officer, Total of basic pension (without commutation value) and dearness allowance thereon as monthly remuneration for Assistant Section Officer.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Retired officers of State Government / semi-government service: Section Officer - from Group A or Group B (Gazetted) cadre in pay structure S-17 to S-23; Assistant Section Officer - from Group B (Gazetted/Non-Gazetted) cadre in pay structure S-14 to S-16. Minimum three years' experience of the relevant work. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only officers retired from State Government / semi-government service may apply. Must be physically, mentally and health-wise fit and capable of the proposed work. No departmental enquiry pending or proposed and no punishment in such an enquiry. Knowledge of office work in Marathi and English; computer handling, MS Office and e-office.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates against whom a departmental enquiry is pending or proposed. Candidates older than 65 years on the date of publication of the advertisement.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Selection considering eligibility, experience, work capability and performance in interview. Eligibility, experience, work capability and performance in interview are considered.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Appointment for at most one year at a time or until the post is filled by the prescribed method, whichever is earlier. Extension as per Government Resolution provisions and decision of the competent authority. No administrative or financial powers will be given.
